meta.name: paid-ads
meta.description: Coordinate safe, evidence-based paid-media work across Google Ads, Meta Ads, X Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok, Amazon, and ChatGPT Ads. Use for broad ads questions, multi-channel strategy, budgets, CPA or ROAS, campaign requests, spend, ad performance, or when routing to the right NotFair paid-ads skill.

copy.tagline: 协调多平台广告投放与预算优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在管理多个渠道的广告投放与预算
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-channel ad campaigns with budget control
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid media across multiple platforms and need to control budget and performance

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问清你的业务目标和预算,再给广告投放建议;如果信息不全,会把建议标成草稿。它还能把你引导到对应的子技能,比如谷歌或 Meta 广告的审计、投放、优化。
howto.when: 当你问到多平台广告策略、预算、CPA/ROAS 等问题,或需要分配合适的广告子技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个新广告活动,预算 5 万元,目标 CPA 50 元
say.note: Claude 会先确认转化和预算信息,再给计划。

say.text: 审查一下我的谷歌广告,看看哪里浪费了钱
say.note: 会进入审计流程,给出可执行的优化建议。

say.text: 对比谷歌和 Meta 的广告效果,我该往哪边加预算?
say.note: 会按业务目标分析并给出分配建议。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude first asks for your business outcome and budget before giving ad advice; incomplete info makes it label suggestions as drafts. It can also route you to the right sub-skill, such as auditing or running Google/Meta ads.
howto.when_en: When you ask about broad ad topics like multi-channel strategy, budget, CPA/ROAS, or need routing to the right paid-ads sub-skill.

say_en.text: Help me plan a new ad campaign with a $5,000 budget and $50 CPA target.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm conversion and budget first.

say_en.text: Review my Google ads and find wasted spend.
say_en.note: It runs an audit and suggests actionable optimizations.

say_en.text: Compare Google and Meta ad performance; where should I add budget?
say_en.note: It analyzes against your goal and gives an allocation suggestion.
